tileEnv.SH_FIXTURE_DESC: A DEC PDP-11 with three of its operating systems behind a chooser. The golden is the chooser itself: a green-on-black 80x31 xterm on a 1024x768 X root listing "1 RT-11 V5.3 (single-user real-time monitor, 11/73, RL02)", "2 RSX-11M V4.2 (multi-user real-time executive, 11/70, RD52)" and "3 RSTS/E V9.6 (multi-user timesharing, 11/70, RD54)", each with the prompt it answers with (. > $) spelled out beside it, over the line "Press 1, 2 or 3. Reset returns you to this screen." The RSTS/E entry carries three extra lines saying plainly that its installer stops one step short, because the second "Library" tape it asks for no longer exists: DCL answers but the packaged commands were never wired up. One keypress boots the chosen system under Open SIMH (pinned to commit a1f57fa3, built into this tile's overlay because the frozen bridge base predates it). RSX-11M is V4.2 BL38, not the V4.3 ceiling of the Mentec grant, because no reachable copy of V4.3 exists; the chooser says V4.2 rather than pretending. Keyboard-only exhibit; no pointer device; the AC97 card is present because the bridge shape always carries it, but nothing inside the guest makes a sound.

reset.fixture: The PDP-11 chooser: a green-on-black 80x31 xterm on a 1024x768 X root naming RT-11 V5.3, RSX-11M V4.2 and RSTS/E V9.6 with the prompt each answers with, over “Press 1, 2 or 3. Reset returns you to this screen.” The RSTS/E line carries its own three-line caveat about the missing Library tape. The golden holds NO running simulator, so reset both returns the visitor to the placard and throws away the session. Certified 2026-08-09 after the bake, by framebuffer: the 80-column rule measured x=3..962 of 1024 on the cold boot, on the restore, and again after the keyboard proof; pressing 1 through QMP input-send-event left the chooser and started a pdp11 process at RT-11FB V05.03, pressing 3 reached RSTS/E V9.6 timesharing and a DCL $, and loadvm golden brought the bare chooser back with no simulator running. Keyboard-only exhibit (no pointer device); AC97 present but the guest makes no sound.
